title: Buckinghamshire Council: Early adoption of Microsoft Copilot
summary: Buckinghamshire Council reports that Microsoft Copilot cut call wrap-up by an average of two minutes a call and helped a deaf colleague take part in meetings more independently.
account: Buckinghamshire Council gained access to Copilot in October 2023 and measured its first savings in that pilot. In an account published on 9 January 2025, the council reports that Copilot saves two minutes per customer-service call and 60–90 minutes daily for a monitored group of six executive assistants. A deaf colleague reportedly participates in meetings and reviews conversations with less assistance. The source does not establish whether that gain persisted. The council also reports hallucinations and inconsistencies in other uses. In October 2025 the Bucks Herald quoted a council report that said that Copilot minute-taking trials were saving 30 minutes per meeting. No outside body has evaluated the Buckinghamshire results.
purpose: Support staff productivity and work quality through transcription, summarization, and drafting.
domain: Local government administration and workplace accessibility

ratings.reason: The council reports less time spent on call wrap-up and executive-assistant tasks.
A deaf colleague can follow speakers, review discussions, and check emails more independently. The duration of that improvement is unknown.

ai_role.statement: The council attributes shorter call wrap-up and drafting tasks to Copilot. Its account also links the transcription functionality to a deaf colleague’s greater independence. The source does not isolate the contribution of each feature or training component.

evidence.citation: Buckinghamshire Council account published by the Local Government Association, Buckinghamshire Council: Early adoption of Microsoft Copilot, 9 January 2025. The LGA compiled it from interviews with the council's IT director and its head of digital, who led the rollout; it gives the council's own time-saving figures and no independent outcome evaluation.
